questions.q: 1. The properties of the materials is influenced by
questions.explain: The physical and mechanical behavior of a material is determined by its chemical composition (constituents), how those atoms are arranged (internal structure), and its surface condition (external structure).

questions.q: 2. The effect of chemical on any building materials is studied under the
questions.explain: Chemical properties describe how a material reacts with external agents like acids, alkalis, or salts, leading to corrosion or degradation.

questions.q: 3. The effect of temperature on any building materials is studied under the
questions.explain: Thermal properties include parameters like thermal conductivity, coefficient of thermal expansion, and fire resistance.
